welcome.title: Welcome to Decorebator! 🎉
welcome.subtitle: Create your wordlist and Decorebator turns it into adaptive quizzes, visuals, and daily practice
welcome.firstWordlistMessage: Your first wordlist is ready! Start adding words to begin learning.

highlight.generator: Make a wordlist; we generate the rest—quizzes, visuals, audio, challenges.

features.heading: See what you can do
features.description: Swipe through the highlights to discover how Decorebator keeps you inspired every day.

quizzes.title: Adaptive quizzes
quizzes.subtitle: Switch between meanings, listening, writing, and picture drills in seconds.
quizzes.bulletTwo: Varied quiz modes ready for micro-sessions.

chat.title: Live speaking coach
chat.subtitle: Pronunciation
chat.bulletOne: Launch a voice session from any wordlist in seconds.
chat.bulletTwo: Realtime transcripts capture every correction you can revisit.

flashcards.title: Smart flashcards
flashcards.subtitle: Flip through definitions, examples, and audio in one tap.
flashcards.bulletOne: Rich cards keep context at your fingertips.

leitner.title: Smart spaced repetition
leitner.subtitle: Leitner boxes time your reviews so words stick long-term.
leitner.bulletTwo: Mastery levels rise as you keep streaks alive.

enrichment.title: AI enrichment pack
enrichment.subtitle: Definitions, examples, visuals, and audio generated for every word.
enrichment.bulletOne: Native-quality pronunciations in your target language.
enrichment.bulletTwo: Examples and visuals that anchor meaning fast.

offline.title: Offline mode
offline.subtitle: Premium lets you practice anywhere with seamless sync.
offline.bulletOne: Download wordlists and keep learning offline.
offline.bulletTwo: Progress syncs automatically when you reconnect.

reporting.title: Report & regenerate
reporting.subtitle: Flag AI mistakes and we regenerate the content fast.
reporting.bulletOne: Report wrong meanings, images, or audio.
reporting.bulletTwo: Quality improves with every report you send.

progress.title: Track your progress
progress.subtitle: Celebrate streaks, mastery levels, and weekly momentum with beautiful charts.
progress.bulletOne: Daily goal reminders keep the streak alive.
progress.bulletTwo: See strengths and gaps by wordlist instantly.

images.title: AI visuals & audio
images.subtitle: Every word gets context with imagery, pronunciation, and cultural nuance.

notifications.title: Stay on track
notifications.subtitle: Gentle reminders nudge you when it’s time to review so your streak never slips.
notifications.morning: Pick morning, afternoon, or evening slots that fit your routine.
notifications.goal: Goal-based reminders react to the daily minutes you picked.
notifications.control: You have full control—toggle them off anytime.

contentGuidelines.title: Content Guidelines
contentGuidelines.description: To ensure a positive learning experience for everyone, please follow these guidelines:

educational.title: Educational Content
educational.description: Focus on vocabulary that helps with language learning and practical use.

familyFriendly.title: Family-Friendly
familyFriendly.description: Keep content appropriate for learners of all ages.

noProfanity.title: No Profanity
noProfanity.description: Avoid offensive language, slurs, or inappropriate content.

noPersonalInfo.title: No Personal Information
noPersonalInfo.description: Don't include personal data, addresses, or contact information.

respectful.title: Respectful Content
respectful.description: Be culturally sensitive and avoid discriminatory content.

legitimate.title: Legitimate Words
legitimate.description: Use real words from the target language, not made-up terms.

contentGuidelines.footer: Thank you for helping create a positive learning environment!

boxDistribution.title: Learning Stage Distribution
boxDistribution.subtitle: Flip through definitions, examples, and audio in one tap.
boxDistribution.explanation: The Leitner system uses 7 boxes with increasing review intervals. Words move up when answered correctly and reset to Box 1 when incorrect. Higher boxes indicate better retention.

historicalBoxDistribution.title: Learning Progress Over Time
historicalBoxDistribution.subtitle: Flip through definitions, examples, and audio in one tap.
historicalBoxDistribution.explanation: This chart shows your mastery percentage over time - the percentage of words that have reached Box 7 (mastered stage). Higher bars indicate better overall vocabulary mastery!
historicalBoxDistribution.stackedExplanation: This stacked bar chart shows how your words are distributed across all 7 Leitner boxes over time. As you progress, words move from red (Box 1 - new) to green (Box 7 - mastered). The growing green area indicates your learning progress!
